summary: Phase 3 full backend + frontend testing executed fresh. Backend: 46/46 pytest pass (14 NEW phase3 + 32 regression). Frontend: all new pages (Editable ELD, Trip Builder, Maintenance, Documents, Fuel/IFTA, Interactive US Weigh Map) render and CRUD works. AI Companion banner Next button verified to fire GET /api/companion/tip + POST /api/tts/speak (Nova TTS, 2 calls each). Detention auto-detect fires on-site cue within ~10s. Fuel auto-prompt toast fires <3s. Sidebar nav items all present. 0 console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='us-weigh-map' is passed to react-leaflet MapContainer but react-leaflet does NOT forward unknown DOM props to the underlying .leaflet-container div, so query_selector for that testid returns null. Map renders correctly with 20 markers (16 green BYPASS + 4 red PULL_IN) and all 20 ws-{id} sidebar items, but the testid is unusable for assertions.

Send button does not expose data-testid='jade-chat-send' (input has jade-chat-input, mute has jade-mute-btn, but send button selector missing). Sending via keyboard Enter timed out the final test in the run. Functionality otherwise intact per iteration_2 manual screenshots.

backend_phase3.evidence: 14/14 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_phase3.py — TTS health+speak (Nova mp3 returned, audio/mpeg >=10KB), ELD CRUD + invalid status (400), Trips CRUD + status patch + invalid status (400), Maintenance CRUD, Documents (list excludes data_base64, detail includes it), Fuel scan with vision fallback + IFTA roll-up + manual entry + delete, Geofence on-site (Phoenix DC 33.4484/-112.074 returns shipper=FreshHarvest Foods · Phoenix DC) + off-site (0,0) + list ≥5, Companion tip non-empty, US weigh stations =20 with required keys.

backend_regression.evidence: 32/32 tests in test_jadeos_api.py + test_phase2.py still pass: auth, HOS, loads, detention, weigh-stations, safety, fleet health, messages, broker dashboard/carriers/exceptions/quote/shipments, jade-chat, bill-scan, integrations CRUD, public /track, settlements, dispatch WebSocket.

ai_companion_banner.evidence: [data-testid='ai-companion-banner'] present on /driver with companion-mute, companion-next, companion-dismiss. Clicking Next fired GET /api/companion/tip (2 calls) + POST /api/tts/speak (2 calls) — Nova TTS integration verified end-to-end via network capture.

editable_eld.evidence: /driver/logs — eld-status/when/location/notes/save all present. Saved a TEST_ event, eld-edit-{id} and eld-del-{id} appeared (2 each), delete worked.

trip_builder.evidence: /driver/trip — all 11 testids present. Saved a TEST_Trip; trip-start-{id} buttons populated (2).

maintenance.evidence: /driver/maintenance — mx-vehicle/cat/title/sev/add all present. Added a TEST_OilChange entry; mx-toggle-{id} and mx-del-{id} populated (3 each, seed + test).

documents.evidence: /driver/documents — doc-file, doc-name, doc-cat, doc-upload all present and clickable.

fuel_ifta.evidence: /driver/fuel — fuel-file + fuel-scan-btn present. Auto-prompt toast 'Jade detected a fuel stop — tap to scan your receipt' rendered within ~3s of page load (screenshot confirmed).

interactive_us_weigh_map.evidence: Leaflet map renders with 16 green BYPASS + 4 red PULL_IN markers. Right sidebar lists 20 stations with ws-{id} testids and BYPASS/PULL-IN badges. NOTE: data-testid='us-weigh-map' is not forwarded by react-leaflet onto the .leaflet-container DOM node.

detention_auto_detect.evidence: [data-testid='detention-auto-toggle'] ON by default (aria-checked=true, data-state=checked). Within 14s the demo cycle ticked through Phoenix DC coords and the on-site indicator (FreshHarvest text / 'On-site' string) appeared in DOM.

gps_moving_driver_marker.evidence: On /driver, GpsMap renders a CircleMarker with tooltip 'RIG-77 · 36%' (animated heading 14→). 0 'Map container is already initialized' errors.

sidebar_nav_new_items.evidence: nav-driver-trip, nav-driver-fuel, nav-driver-maintenance, nav-driver-documents all present on driver sidebar.

broker_regression.evidence: Broker login → command center shows Loads 47, Active Quotes 12, MTD Revenue $1842k, Avg Margin 18.6%, Exceptions 3 (screenshot). quote-optimize-btn → quote-result populated. Carriers page lists Reyes with LOW/MEDIUM. Exceptions page shows HOS/OVERWEIGHT cards. Public /track/JL-2026-00917 renders tracking text.

console_errors.evidence: 0 console errors across all visited routes (driver dashboard, logs, trip, maintenance, documents, fuel, weigh, detention, jade, broker dashboard, quote, carriers, exceptions, /track).

action_items: (Minor testability) Add data-testid='jade-chat-send' onto the JADE chat send button — currently input has the testid but send does not, blocking automated chat triggering.

(Minor testability) react-leaflet does not forward arbitrary props to the .leaflet-container DOM. Move data-testid='us-weigh-map' onto a wrapper <div> around the <MapContainer> so it is queryable, or pass via `whenCreated`/ref to set it imperatively.
critical_code_review_comments: phase3.py defines an inner MaintenanceEntry class (line 206) inside make_router that shadows the module-level MaintenanceEntry (line 67). Both have the same fields so behaviour is identical, but the inner duplicate should be removed for clarity.
phase3.py defines unused inner GeoPing_ class (line 410) — dead code, safe to remove.
phase3.py /maintenance PATCH accepts an unrestricted `dict` body — consider Pydantic model to validate fields (low risk because auth is enforced).
tts.py: when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing /tts/health returns ok:false but /tts/speak returns 503 — UI should gate the button on health, currently it always attempts a POST.
Frontend WeighStationsPage.jsx uses CircleMarker; consider clustering for dense markers when dataset grows beyond 20.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (2 minor data-testid gaps; all functionality verified)

seed_data_creation: Tests prefix all created data with TEST_ and clean up via DELETE after each test. ELD/Trip/Maintenance/Document/Fuel records were created and removed within the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 backend is solid (46/46 pytest). Only 2 minor frontend testability gaps: us-weigh-map testid not forwarded by react-leaflet, jade-chat-send button has no testid. The mocked APIs (fuel scan fallback to Love's #423, detention cycle every 4s between Phoenix DC and Gallup, US weigh sample of 20) all behave per spec. AI Companion banner verified to call /api/companion/tip + /api/tts/speak — Nova TTS works end-to-end (curl returned 31KB MP3 per main agent, our test confirmed audio/mpeg + >=10KB body).
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — no regressions or bugs found in Phase 3.
